name: Tokuji Tsuruta
description:
The keeper of the shrine, seventy-eight years old, deeply lined, in a padded indigo coat, who sweeps the paving every night and has done for sixty years. He leans on his broom before he says anything he thinks is important, and talks to the shrine cat as if the cat were in charge. Slow, dry and old-town plain: he says exactly what he means and not a word more.

He wants the shrine to stay where it is, and for someone younger to care about it when he can no longer hold a broom.
